answer: At registration, each key locks a proposed  accuracy bond and submits forecasts on three randomly selected public metrics; after reveal, an independent oracle releases the bond only if the score reaches 70%, otherwise it slashes it before activation. This is a proposal, not a current protocol rule. One honest agent locks  once; 1,000 fake identities must lock ,000 (1,000 × ), with every bond at risk. Seed tasks with reef/forge/fable. Limitation: skilled attackers can forecast well, and oracle collusion can defeat enforcement.
